explanation_en: 'Al parecer' is a very common adverbial locution meaning 'apparently' or 'seemingly'. It is used to report information that seems to be true based on evidence or hearsay, without fully committing to its absolute certainty. It is a staple of journalistic and everyday spoken Spanish.

examples.en_text: Apparently, it's going to rain this weekend, so we'll have to cancel the excursion.
examples.target_text: Al parecer, va a llover este fin de semana, así que tendremos que cancelar la excursión.

examples.en_text: Apparently, the new director has a lot of experience in the technology sector.
examples.target_text: Al parecer, el nuevo director tiene mucha experiencia en el sector tecnológico.

examples.en_text: He didn't come to the meeting because, apparently, he didn't receive the invitation email.
examples.target_text: No vino a la reunión porque, al parecer, no recibió el correo electrónico de invitación.

examples.en_text: Apparently, I lost my keys in the park on the way home.
examples.target_text: Al parecer, perdí mis llaves en el parque de camino a casa.

examples.en_text: Sofía won't come to class today; apparently, she has a pretty bad flu.
examples.target_text: Sofía no vendrá hoy a clase; al parecer, tiene una gripe bastante fuerte.

examples.en_text: Apparently, our flight is delayed by two hours due to bad weather.
examples.target_text: Al parecer, nuestro vuelo tiene un retraso de dos horas por el mal tiempo.

explanation_en: This expression is used to review, summarize, or look back on a series of events, a life story, or a set of information. It is highly common in journalism, academic contexts, and casual conversations when summarizing. It literally means 'to make a review'.

examples.en_text: I am reviewing the exam topics before going to bed.
examples.target_text: Estoy haciendo un repaso de los temas del examen antes de acostarme.

examples.en_text: The team is reviewing the project to see what we can improve.
examples.target_text: El equipo está haciendo un repaso del proyecto para ver qué podemos mejorar.

examples.en_text: Looking back on my life, I realize how much I have changed.
examples.target_text: Haciendo un repaso de mi vida, me doy cuenta de lo mucho que he cambiado.

examples.en_text: We will start the meeting by reviewing the pending tasks.
examples.target_text: Empezaremos la reunión haciendo un repaso de las tareas pendientes.

examples.en_text: We were looking back at the trip photos and we laughed a lot.
examples.target_text: Estábamos haciendo un repaso de las fotos del viaje y nos reímos mucho.

examples.en_text: I have been spending the whole afternoon reviewing my monthly expenses.
examples.target_text: Llevo toda la tarde haciendo un repaso de mis gastos mensuales.

explanation_en: A very common colloquial and semi-formal transition phrase used to explain the reason or context behind something. It literally means 'due to the subject/issue of'. It is often used instead of simpler prepositions like 'por' or 'debido a' to sound more explanatory.

examples.en_text: We had to change the date of the meeting due to the transport strike.
examples.target_text: Tuvimos que cambiar la fecha de la reunión por el tema de la huelga de transporte.

examples.en_text: I've decided to eat less meat, especially because of the health issue.
examples.target_text: He decidido comer menos carne, sobre todo por el tema de la salud.

examples.en_text: We couldn't travel to the beach due to the bad weather issue.
examples.target_text: No pudimos viajar a la playa por el tema del mal tiempo.

examples.en_text: Many young people cannot buy a house because of the issue of such high prices.
examples.target_text: Mucha gente joven no puede comprar una casa por el tema de los precios tan altos.

examples.en_text: I prefer working from home due to the issue of saving time in traffic.
examples.target_text: Prefiero trabajar desde casa por el tema de ahorrar tiempo en el tráfico.

examples.en_text: I didn't enroll in that course due to the schedule issue, which didn't suit me.
examples.target_text: No me matriculé en ese curso por el tema del horario, que no me iba bien.

explanation_en: This fixed phrase means to be in communication or in touch with someone. It can be used with the preposition 'con' to specify the person or entity. It is standard in both professional and personal settings.

examples.en_text: Even though we live in different cities, it's important to stay in touch.
examples.target_text: Aunque vivamos en ciudades diferentes, es importante estar en contacto.

examples.en_text: We will be in touch next week to confirm the details of the project.
examples.target_text: Estaremos en contacto la próxima semana para confirmar los detalles del proyecto.

examples.en_text: During the pandemic, we were in touch through video calls almost every day.
examples.target_text: Durante la pandemia, estuvimos en contacto a través de videollamadas casi todos los días.

examples.en_text: It's important that we stay in touch during the trip in case something happens.
examples.target_text: Es importante que estemos en contacto durante el viaje por si pasa algo.

examples.en_text: Before, I wasn't in touch with my cousins, but now we write to each other a lot.
examples.target_text: Antes no estaba en contacto con mis primos, pero ahora nos escribimos mucho.

examples.en_text: I would like to be in touch with professionals in my field to share ideas.
examples.target_text: Me gustaría estar en contacto con profesionales de mi sector para compartir ideas.

explanation_en: This noun phrase refers to the person who provides the primary financial support for a household. 'Sostén' literally means 'support' or 'prop'. It is a standard, respectful term used in sociological, legal, and everyday contexts.

examples.en_text: Since her husband lost his job, she has become the sole breadwinner of the family.
examples.target_text: Desde que su esposo perdió el trabajo, ella se ha convertido en el único sostén de la familia.

examples.en_text: Despite being very young, Carlos took on the responsibility of being the family breadwinner.
examples.target_text: A pesar de ser muy joven, Carlos asumió la responsabilidad de ser el sostén de la familia.

examples.en_text: My grandfather was always proud to have been the main breadwinner of the family for so many years.
examples.target_text: Mi abuelo siempre estuvo orgulloso de haber sido el principal sostén de la familia durante tantos años.

examples.en_text: Nowadays, in many couples, both share the task of being the family breadwinner.
examples.target_text: Hoy en día, en muchas parejas ambos comparten la tarea de ser el sostén de la familia.

examples.en_text: He felt a lot of pressure from being the sole breadwinner of the family and not being able to take a vacation.
examples.target_text: Sentía mucha presión por ser el único sostén de la familia y no poder tomarse unas vacaciones.

examples.en_text: We want to thank our mother, who worked tirelessly as the breadwinner of the family.
examples.target_text: Queremos agradecer a nuestra madre, quien trabajó incansablemente como el sostén de la familia.

explanation_en: A very common colloquial idiom meaning to help someone. It is equivalent to the English 'to lend a hand'. It is widely used in informal and semi-formal contexts throughout the Spanish-speaking world.

examples.en_text: I am lending my brother a hand with his move to his new apartment.
examples.target_text: Estoy dando una mano a mi hermano con la mudanza de su nuevo apartamento.

examples.en_text: If you have trouble with the homework, let me know and I'll lend you a hand.
examples.target_text: Si tienes problemas con la tarea, avísame y te doy una mano.

examples.en_text: The neighbor lent me a hand to repair the car yesterday afternoon.
examples.target_text: El vecino me dio una mano para reparar el coche ayer por la tarde.

examples.en_text: Could you lend me a hand with these bags? They are too heavy.
examples.target_text: ¿Podrías darme una mano con estas bolsas? Pesan demasiado.

examples.en_text: I really appreciate you lending me a hand at this very difficult time.
examples.target_text: Agradezco mucho que me estés dando una mano en este momento tan difícil.

examples.en_text: All the neighbors are lending a hand to clean up the neighborhood park.
examples.target_text: Todos los vecinos están dando una mano para limpiar el parque del barrio.

explanation_en: This grammatical collocation is used to indicate that an action is imminent or very close to happening. It is followed by an infinitive verb or a noun phrase. It is an essential structure for B2/C1 learners to express close proximity in time or state.

examples.en_text: We were about to leave when it started to rain heavily.
examples.target_text: Estábamos a punto de salir cuando empezó a llover fuerte.

examples.en_text: Save the document right now, the laptop battery is about to run out.
examples.target_text: Guarda el documento ahora mismo, la batería del portátil está a punto de agotarse.

examples.en_text: She was so moved that she was on the verge of crying during the speech.
examples.target_text: Ella estaba tan emocionada que estuvo a punto de llorar durante el discurso.

examples.en_text: Watch out for the milk, it's about to boil.
examples.target_text: Cuidado con la leche, que está a punto de hervir.

examples.en_text: I was on the verge of accepting that job, but in the end I decided to stay here.
examples.target_text: Estuve a punto de aceptar ese trabajo, pero al final decidí quedarme aquí.

examples.en_text: Hurry up, the movie is about to start and I don't want to miss the beginning.
examples.target_text: Date prisa, la película está a punto de empezar y no quiero perder el inicio.

explanation_en: A highly colloquial expression meaning to abandon someone, leave them in the lurch, or fail to help them in a time of need. 'Tirado' literally means 'thrown' or 'lying on the ground'. It carries a strong emotional connotation of betrayal or neglect.

examples.en_text: The bus driver left us stranded in the middle of the road.
examples.target_text: El conductor del autobús nos dejó tirados en mitad de la carretera.

examples.en_text: His partner left him stranded with all the company's debts.
examples.target_text: Su socio lo dejó tirado con todas las deudas de la empresa.

examples.en_text: I can't believe your boyfriend left you stranded right before the party.
examples.target_text: No puedo creer que tu novio te dejara tirada justo antes de la fiesta.

examples.en_text: The car broke down and left us stranded on the highway at night.
examples.target_text: El coche se averió y nos dejó tirados en la autopista de noche.

examples.en_text: They canceled the flight at the last minute and left hundreds of passengers stranded.
examples.target_text: Cancelaron el vuelo a última hora y dejaron tirados a cientos de pasajeros.

examples.en_text: If you leave me stranded now that I need you, I won't trust you again.
examples.target_text: Si me dejas tirado ahora que te necesito, no volveré a confiar en ti.

explanation_en: Used colloquially and in media to indicate starting an event, show, or presentation with a specific segment. It is highly dynamic compared to the standard 'empezar con'.

examples.en_text: Today we kick off with the most important news of the week.
examples.target_text: Hoy arrancamos con las noticias más importantes de la semana.

examples.en_text: To make this cake, we start with the liquid ingredients.
examples.target_text: Para preparar este pastel, arrancamos con los ingredientes líquidos.

examples.en_text: The concert kicks off with their most famous song.
examples.target_text: El concierto arranca con su canción más famosa.

examples.en_text: We are starting with a review of last month's sales.
examples.target_text: Arrancamos con un repaso de las ventas del mes pasado.

examples.en_text: In this course, we start with the most basic concepts.
examples.target_text: En este curso, arrancamos con los conceptos más básicos.

examples.en_text: We kick off with a visit to the historic center of the city.
examples.target_text: Arrancamos con una visita al centro histórico de la ciudad.

explanation_en: Frequently used in news reporting to describe the final count of casualties, injuries, or damages after a disaster or attack. 'Saldo' here refers to the net outcome or balance of an event.

examples.en_text: The toll left by last night's storm was three fallen trees and several flooded streets.
examples.target_text: El saldo que dejó la tormenta de anoche fue de tres árboles caídos y varias calles inundadas.

examples.en_text: The toll left by inflation this year is a great loss of purchasing power for families.
examples.target_text: El saldo que deja la inflación este año es una gran pérdida de poder adquisitivo para las familias.

examples.en_text: The police confirmed that the toll resulting from the highway accident was two minor injuries.
examples.target_text: La policía confirmó que el saldo que dejó el accidente en la autopista fue de dos heridos leves.

examples.en_text: Beyond the material damage, the toll left by the strike is a deep division within the team.
examples.target_text: Más allá de los daños materiales, el saldo que deja la huelga es una profunda división en el equipo.

examples.en_text: The toll left by working without resting is always physical and mental exhaustion.
examples.target_text: El saldo que deja trabajar sin descansar es siempre el agotamiento físico y mental.

examples.en_text: The toll left by the forest fire was more than one hundred hectares of burned forest.
examples.target_text: El saldo que dejó el incendio forestal fue de más de cien hectáreas de bosque quemadas.

explanation_en: Originating from boxing, this metaphor is widely used in politics, business, and military contexts to describe a highly influential, powerful, or key figure.

examples.en_text: The new chief technology officer is a heavyweight in the industry.
examples.target_text: El nuevo director de tecnología es un peso pesado de la industria.

examples.en_text: To win the elections, the party needs a heavyweight in politics.
examples.target_text: Para ganar las elecciones, el partido necesita a un peso pesado de la política.

examples.en_text: Although she is young, she is already a heavyweight in the sales department.
examples.target_text: Aunque es joven, ella ya es una peso pesado en el departamento de ventas.

examples.en_text: They invited a heavyweight of cinema to give the opening lecture.
examples.target_text: Invitaron a un peso pesado del cine para dar la conferencia de apertura.

examples.en_text: Only the heavyweights of the company will participate in tomorrow's meeting.
examples.target_text: En la reunión de mañana solo participarán los pesos pesados de la empresa.

examples.en_text: It's not easy to negotiate with him; he is a business heavyweight.
examples.target_text: No es fácil negociar con él; es un peso pesado de los negocios.

explanation_en: 'Diana' means target or bullseye. Being 'en la diana de' means being targeted, scrutinized, or singled out by someone, often in a hostile or critical manner.

examples.en_text: The minister of economy is in the crosshairs of the opposition because of the new law.
examples.target_text: El ministro de economía está en la diana de la oposición por la nueva ley.

examples.en_text: After making that mistake, the marketing director ended up in the boss's crosshairs.
examples.target_text: Después de cometer ese error, el director de marketing quedó en la diana del jefe.

examples.en_text: Big tech companies are now in the crosshairs of European regulators.
examples.target_text: Las grandes empresas tecnológicas ahora están en la diana de los reguladores europeos.

examples.en_text: The team's coach is in the crosshairs of the fans after the latest defeat.
examples.target_text: El entrenador del equipo está en la diana de los aficionados tras la última derrota.

examples.en_text: The plastic industry finds itself in the crosshairs of environmental groups.
examples.target_text: La industria del plástico se encuentra en la diana de los grupos ecologistas.

examples.en_text: Since he posted that controversial tweet, the singer has been in the crosshairs of criticism.
examples.target_text: Desde que publicó ese polémico tuit, el cantante ha estado en la diana de las críticas.
